test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Amongst six people, D, E, F, G, H, and I, each has a different age. They are standing in a line according to their age in an increasing order. F is older than E but younger than D. D is younger than I. E is older than G. G is older than H. Who comes in 4th position in increasing order of age?
solution:
Given: Amongst six people, D, E, F, G, H, and I, each has a different age.

1) F is older than E but younger than D.

D > F > E

2) D is younger than I.

I > D > F > E

3) E is older than G.

I > D > F > E > G

4) G is older than H.

I > D > F > E > G > H

So,** F** comes in 4th position in increasing order of age.

Hence, the correct answer is "F".
